prompt:
Use case: style-transfer / precise-object-edit.
Image 1 is the approved Wili weapon design, the edit target. Image 2 shows actual original Don't Starve Together item sprites at the same game scale, and is only a reference for ink linework and simple readable shading.

Polish Image 1 for actual in-game readability while preserving its EXACT silhouette and identity. Do not design a different knife.
Preserve the downward reverse-grip orientation, the left convex silver cutting edge and lower-right curving tip, crescent pommel, dark navy wrapped grip, paired crescent guard, and the borderless circular moon medallion with a pale crescent and tightly tessellated dark multicolored gemstone tiles. The gemstone tiles remain edge-to-edge like a fitted stone mosaic. Preserve all proportions and attachment locations.

The issue to correct: the weapon currently has many small mottled faceted patches and thin fussy internal strokes that disappear into muddy noise at game size and look unlike the simple hand-inked base-game items.
Repaint the INTERNAL surfaces into a few larger, confident flat color shapes:
- Silver metal: one cool pale silver-gray base, one clean near-white cutting bevel, one compact charcoal-gray shadow. Keep silver clearly silver, never beige bone or green glass. Remove almost all all-over tiny triangular marbling and white scratch confetti.
- Grip: dark desaturated ink navy, just two tone blocks per wrap, clearly readable winding bands. No blue crystal/stone texture and no bright blue cloth.
- Blade back: a simple deep graphite plane with at most a few deliberate short pen hatches.
- Moon tiles: larger flat dark colored patches separated by clear thin black seams, keep the fitted tile layout, no extra microfacets inside each tile. Restrained colors, overall dark. Keep the pale crescent readable and unframed.
- Outer contours should have the bold, slightly uneven and confident black ink of the original game sprites, roughly 30-40% stronger than the existing contour, without changing the weapon silhouette or making the outline a decorative border.
Use only a few purposeful scratchy pen strokes for hand-drawn character. Retain the approved elegant shape and cool silver / dark navy palette. No detailed 3D texture, no smooth metallic gradient, no photoreal shading, no new damage, ornament, jewel shapes, ribbons or extra details.
Do NOT add any ground shadow or grass to this master image: the native game ground-only shadow is a separate layer.
One complete weapon alone in exactly the same upright layout, centered with clean genuine alpha transparency. No text, labels, paper, background color, glow, haze or checkered pattern. Opaque interior pixels and fully transparent exterior pixels.
source_reference: Previous approved cold-silver/ink-navy crescent weapon with fitted dark gem tiles.
style_reference: Actual native weapon sprites from the installed game, compared at equal scale.
production_processing: Alpha normalization and sprite registration only; ground scale1.65 and held scale1.35 applied through build geometry. Separate native ground contact strokes use unchanged original size.
